instruction: Adjust all text in textboxes on slides 4 and 5 so the font size is 18 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font size to 18pt for all text in textboxes on slides 4 and 5 (0-indexed: 3 and 4). Slide 4 has 7 textboxes, slide 5 has 2 textboxes. Evaluator checks font sizes with 0.5pt tolerance and provides partial credit based on the proportion of textboxes with correct font size.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets slides 4 and 5 (0-indexed as slides 3 and 4)
Postconfig properly saves the file before reading, ensuring fresh state
Partial credit logic is reasonable for multi-textbox verification
Expected value (18pt) correctly matches the instruction requirement
Semantic imprecision: Getter calculates average font size per textbox rather than verifying every text run is 18pt. If a textbox has mixed font sizes averaging to 18pt, it would incorrectly pass
Edge case handling: Getter appends None when no font sizes found, but metric skips None values which could cause total_textboxes=0 if all textboxes lack explicit font sizes
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying that ALL text runs in each textbox are 18pt, not just the average. Iterate through all runs and check that each is within tolerance of 18pt
Add explicit handling for default font sizes when run.font.size is None, rather than appending None to the list
Consider adding a minimum threshold check to ensure at least some textboxes were found (avoid score=0.0 from division when total_textboxes=0)
